data.name: Muwarrij
data.gender_notes: Muwarrij is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who strives or fights for a righteous cause. A warrior in the way of Allah. The name Muwarrij carries the meaning “Striving, Warrior” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muwarrij usually hope their child will grow to embody striving, warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes determination, courage, and devotion to one's faith.
data.etymology: Muwarrij belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Striving, Warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muwarrij total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: مورج
in_arabic.long_meaning: مورج هو اسم عربي مشتق من الفعل ورج الذي يعني التأمل والتفكر في الأمور، ويشير إلى الشخص الذي يفكر深وا في الأ-events والقضايا، هذا الاسم له أهمية كبيرة في الثقافة الإسلامية حيث يُشجع على التفكر والتدبر في القرآن الكريم وال_sunna_ النبوية

in_urdu.name: مورج
in_urdu.long_meaning: مورج ایک عربی نام ہے جو ورج سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا معنی ہے گہری فکر اور غورو فکر، یہ نام اسلام میں بہت اہم ہے کیونکہ قرآن پاک اور سنت نبوی میں تفکر و تدبر کی تلقین کی گئی ہے

in_hindi.name: मुवारिज

in_pashto.name: موارج

data.cultural_impact: The name Muwarrij signifies a person of strength, courage, and commitment to a just cause in Islamic culture. In the historical context, many great Muslim leaders and warriors held this name, thereby leaving an inspiring and heroic legacy in the annals of Islamic history.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Muwarrij is a reminder of the importance of striving for righteousness in the sight of Allah. In the Quran, the phrase "Muwarrijun 'Alaihim" is used to describe those who will wage "jihad" in the way of Allah, and those who struggle in His way even in times of peace. Thus, Muwarrij embodies the spiritual pursuit of self-improvement and the quest for justice and righteousness in the human condition.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Muwarrij was a prominent companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Muwarrij carried significant weight in that era.
